relations.label: The parlour melody returns
relations.basis: The paired spans lie in the middle parlour-music episode, whose melodic paragraph recurs. Kyle Gann describes its two turns towards Wagner’s wedding tune at https://charlesives.org/node/6616; this link concerns the longer paragraph, not an individually timed quotation. CENS diagonal mean 0.940, sustained 29 s, fixed pitch-class shift 0 semitones and time offset 40.5 s (cache/form/ives-concord-alcotts.txt, candidate 1; 0.5 s grid). These are matched excerpts, not complete section boundaries; timing has not been checked by ear.

candidatesRejected: No qualifying path connects the opening with the final C-major statement of the human-faith melody. The shared Beethoven rhythm is too short to justify an arc by itself. The one retained match is local to the middle episode and is not labelled a recapitulation of the entire movement.
